messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: onboarding sampleapp failed because the Node SDK doesn't expose the admin models endpoint we rely on (we need quantProfiles + costTier).

alex: which admin path? can you paste the curl?

maria: `GET /admin/models/list` returns full metadata when called via curl with the org key. SDK's listModels() only hits `/v1/models` and drops admin-only fields.

sam: confirmed locally. Also noticed param name mismatch: REST filter expects `model_version` but SDK sends `modelVersion`. Admin route ignores unknown keys and returns the default list -> UI silently used latest.

diana: silent fallbacks ruin first-run UX. server should 400 on unknown admin filters at least during onboarding.

alex: short-term: I'll add `client.admin.listModels()` to the SDK and a param normalizer that accepts both snake_case and camelCase for known filters. Will open a PR tomorrow.

maria: I patched sampleapp to call the REST endpoint directly as a stopgap and that fixed the selector. I'll push a repro snippet to the PR.

sam: I'll add e2e coverage asserting admin fields are present and tests for both `model_version` and `modelVersion`.

devex-bot: Created issue RDW-4680: "SDK: admin models endpoint + param aliasing" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4680

diana: also file a follow-up for the streaming parity: SDK buffers stream chunks more than REST and that broke our onboarding progress bar. Not blocking but put it in Known Issues.

alex: noted. plan: SDK patch + types + migration notes + minor release. Sam/maria please link tests and sampleapp PR to RDW-4680.

maria: done, PR link in thread when ready. thanks everyone :rocket:
